wvs7 <- read_excel("D:/magang/Project Religiositas/Data Pisa/Indonesia/WVS_Wave_7_Indonesia_Excel.xlsx")
wvs5 <- read_excel("D:/magang/Project Religiositas/Data Pisa/Indonesia/WV5_Data_Indonesia_Excel.xlsx")
wvs4 <- read_excel("D:/magang/Project Religiositas/Data Pisa/Indonesia/WV4_Data_Indonesia_Excel.xlsx")


## Data World Values Survey 7
wvs7idn <- wvs7 |> 
  select("Q260: Sex", 
         "Q262: Age", 
         "X003R: Age recoded (6 intervals)",
         "Q289: Religious denominations - major groups",
         "Q6: Important in life: Religion",
         "Q164: Importance of God",
         "Q275: Highest educational level: Respondent [ISCED 2011]",
         "Q165: Believe in: God", 
         "Q171: How often do you attend religious services", 
         "Q172: How often do you pray", 
         "Q173: Religious person",
         "Q166: Believe in: life after death",
         "Q167: Believe in: hell",
         "Q168: Believe in: heaven") |> 
  rename(sex = "Q260: Sex", 
         umur = "Q262: Age",
         usia = "X003R: Age recoded (6 intervals)",
         Kelompok_agama = "Q289: Religious denominations - major groups",
         percaya_tuhan = "Q165: Believe in: God",
         Agamapenting = "Q6: Important in life: Religion",
         God_penting = "Q164: Importance of God",
         Pendterakhir = "Q275: Highest educational level: Respondent [ISCED 2011]",
         Kehadiran = "Q171: How often do you attend religious services",
         Tingkat_keagamaan = "Q172: How often do you pray",
         orang_religius = "Q173: Religious person",
         Percaya_tuhan = "Q165: Believe in: God",
         percaya_afterlife = "Q166: Believe in: life after death",
         percaya_neraka = "Q167: Believe in: hell",
         percaya_surga = "Q168: Believe in: heaven")|>
  mutate(Pendterakhir = as.character(Pendterakhir)) |>
  filter(!Pendterakhir %in% c('-1', '0')) |>
  mutate(sex_responden = dplyr::recode(as.character(sex),
                                       '1'= 'Perempuan',
                                       '2'= 'Laki-laki'),
         usia = dplyr::recode(usia,
                           '1' = "18-24",
                           '2' = "25-34",
                           '3' = "35-44",
                           '4' = "45-54", 
                           '5' = "55-64", 
                           '6' = ">65"),
         Agamapenting = dplyr::recode(as.character(Agamapenting),
                                      '1'= '4',
                                      '2'= '3',
                                      '3'= '2',
                                      '4'= '1'),
         Kelompok_agama = dplyr::recode(as.character(Kelompok_agama),
                                        '0'='Tidak ada',
                                        '1'='Katholik roma',
                                        '2'='Protestan',
                                        '3'='Orthodox',
                                        '4'='Yahudi',
                                        '5'='Muslim',
                                        '6'='Hindu',
                                        '7'='Budha',
                                        '8'='Lainnya',
                                        '9'='Kong Hu Cu'),
         Pendterakhir = dplyr::recode(as.character(Pendterakhir),
                               '1'='SD',
                               '2'='SMP',
                               '3'='SMA',
                               '4'='Sarjana',
                               '5'='Sarjana',
                               '6'='Sarjana',
                               '7'='Sarjana',
                               '8'='Sarjana'),
         orang_religius = dplyr::recode(as.character(orang_religius),
                                        '1'='3',
                                        '2'='2',
                                        '3'='1' )) |>
  mutate(Pendterakhir = factor(Pendterakhir,
                           levels = c("SD", "SMP", "SMA", "Sarjana")))
nrow(wvs7idn)
[1] 2888
WVS7IDN <- wvs7idn |>
  filter(!is.na(Pendterakhir), 
         !is.na(Kehadiran), 
         usia !="18-24") |>
  droplevels() |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
  )) |>
   dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting,
      orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ ifelse(.< 0,NA,.)
  ))   |>
mutate(across(
    c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting),
    ~ (. - min(., na.rm = TRUE)) /
      (max(., na.rm = TRUE) - min(., na.rm = TRUE))    ## distandarisasi 
  )) |>
  mutate(Religiositas = rowMeans(
    across(c(Kehadiran, Agamapenting, orang_religius, God_penting)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ))

wvs5idn <- wvs5 |> 
  select("V237: Age",
         "V235: Sex",
         "V9: Important in life: Religion",
         "V238: Highest educational level: Respondent",
         "V185G: Religious denomination -Main group",
         "V186: How often do you attend religious services",
         "V187: Religious person",
         "V237R2: Age recoded (3 intervals)",
         "V192: How important is god in your life",
         "V237R: Age recoded (6 intervals)") |>
  rename(umur = "V237: Age",
         Usia = "V237R2: Age recoded (3 intervals)",
         usia_responden ="V237R: Age recoded (6 intervals)",
         Jenis_kelamin = "V235: Sex",
         agama_penting = "V9: Important in life: Religion",
         Pend_terakhir = "V238: Highest educational level: Respondent",
         Intensitas_keagamaan = "V186: How often do you attend religious services",
         individu_beragama = "V187: Religious person",
         Keyakinan = "V185G: Religious denomination -Main group",
         Tuhan_penting = "V192: How important is god in your life")|>
  mutate(Keyakinan = as.character(Keyakinan),
         Pend_terakhir = as.character(Pend_terakhir)) |>

                                    '-1'='tidak tahu',

                                    '2'='Protestan',

                                           '1' = '3',

    mutate(Pend_terakhir = factor(Pend_terakhir,

WVS4IDN <- wvs4idn |>
  filter(!is.na(Pend_done), 
         !is.na(Jumlah_kehadiran), 
         usia != "18-24") |>
  droplevels() |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Jumlah_kehadiran, Anggapan_beragama, religion_penting, tuhan_penting),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.)))
  )) |>
   dplyr::mutate(across(
    c(Jumlah_kehadiran, Anggapan_beragama,
      religion_penting, tuhan_penting),
    ~ ifelse(. < 0, NA, .)
  )) |>  
  mutate(across(
    c(Jumlah_kehadiran, Anggapan_beragama,
      religion_penting, tuhan_penting),
    ~ (. - min(., na.rm = TRUE)) /
      (max(., na.rm = TRUE) - min(., na.rm = TRUE))     ## distandarisasi
  )) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Religiositas = rowMeans(
    dplyr::across(c(Jumlah_kehadiran, Anggapan_beragama, religion_penting, tuhan_penting)),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )) |> drop_na()

Mengolah data

distribusi rata-rata religiositas masy indonesia

## WVS 4 Indonesia
wvs_summary <- WVS4IDN |>
  group_by(Pend_done) |>
  summarise(
    rata_religiositas = mean(Religiositas, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  arrange(rata_religiositas) |>  
  mutate(Pend_done = factor(Pend_done, levels = Pend_done)) |>
  as_tibble()


qq4 <- ggplot(
  wvs_summary,
  aes(
    x = Pend_done,
    y = rata_religiositas,
    fill = Pend_done
  )
) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(rata_religiositas, 2), " (n=", n, ")")),
    hjust = -0.3, size = 2, color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "World Value Surveys Indonesia gelombang 4 (1999-2004)",
    x = "Tingkat Pendidikan",
    y = "Rata-rata Religiositas"
  ) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off", expand = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "SD" = "#6BAED6",       
      "SMP" = "#BDD7E7",
      "SMA" = "#2171B5",
      "Sarjana" = "#08306B"   
    ),
    guide = "none"   
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 60, 10, 10)
  )
wvsindo <- textGrob(
  "Distribusi nilai Rata-rata Religiositas berdasarkan Tingkat Pendidikan",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
)

caption <- textGrob(
  "Sumber: World Values Survey Indonesia gelombang 4",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  just = "right"
)

distribusi <- grid.arrange(
  wvsindo,
  qq4,
  caption,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 4, 0.6)
  )
ggsave("Distibusi_religiositas_wvs4.png", distribusi, dpi = 800)

  gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold")
)

caption <- textGrob(
  "Sumber: World Values Survey Indonesia gelombang 7",
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  just = "right"
)

distribusi <- grid.arrange(
  wvsindo,
  qq7,
  caption,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1, 4, 0.6)
  )
ggsave("Distibusi_religiositas_wvs7.png", distribusi, dpi = 800)

Tabel Deskripsi

# Fungsi untuk membuat tabel distribusi 
buat_tabel <- function(var, nama_var){
  tab <- table(var)
  df <- data.frame(
    Variabel = nama_var,
    Kategori = names(tab),
    Jumlah = as.vector(tab),
    Persen = round(prop.table(tab) * 100, 1)
  )
  return(df)
}

# Buat tabel untuk setiap variabel 
tabel_kelamin   <- buat_tabel(wvs4idn$jenis_kelamin, "Jenis Kelamin")
tabel_usia      <- buat_tabel(wvs4idn$usia, "Kelompok Usia")
tabel_pendidikan<- buat_tabel(wvs4idn$Pend_done, "Jenjang Pendidikan")
tabel_agama     <- buat_tabel(wvs4idn$Kepercayaan, "Agama")

# Gabungkan semua tabel jadi satu 
tabel_final <- rbind(tabel_kelamin, tabel_usia, tabel_pendidikan, tabel_agama)

# Membuat tabel data responden
ft <- flextable(tabel_final) |>
  set_header_labels(
    Variabel = "Variabel", 
    kategori_summary = "Kategori", 
    Jumlah = "Jumlah", 
    Persen = "Persen (%)"
  ) |>
  add_header_lines("Tabel 2. Statistik Deskriptif Data Responden WVS 4") |>
  merge_v(j = "Variabel") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>

  # FONT Times New Roman
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |>
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") |>

  # Header lebih tebal
  bold(part = "header") |>
  bold(i = 1, part = "header") |>

  autofit()

)

Hasil analisis regresi

## Analisis Regresi WVS Indonesia 4
uji_regresi_4 <- lm(Religiositas ~ Pend_done, data = WVS4IDN)

# untuk hasil R2
r2 <- summary(uji_regresi_4)$r.squared
adj_r2 <- summary(uji_regresi_4)$adj.r.squared

# ambil hasil regresi
hasil_reg <- tidy(uji_regresi_4, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    Variabel = dplyr::recode(term,
      "(Intercept)" = "(Intercept)",
      "Pend_doneSMP" = "SMP",
      "Pend_doneSMA" = "SMA",
      "Pend_doneSarjana" = "Sarjana"
    ),
    estimate = round(estimate, 3),
    std.error = round(std.error, 3),
    CI = paste0(
      round(conf.low, 3),
      " – ",
      round(conf.high, 3)
    ), 
    p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p.value, 3)),
    Signif = case_when(
      p.value == "<0.001" ~ "***",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.01 ~ "**",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  select(Variabel, estimate, std.error, CI, p.value, Signif) |>
  rename(
    Koefisien = estimate,
    `Std. Error` = std.error,
    `CI (95%)` = CI,
    `p-value` = p.value
  )
Warning: There were 2 warnings in `mutate()`.
The first warning was:
ℹ In argument: `Signif = case_when(...)`.
Caused by warning:
! NAs introduced by coercion
ℹ Run `dplyr::last_dplyr_warnings()` to see the 1 remaining warning.
# buat tabel
ft <- flextable(hasil_reg) |>
  set_caption("Tabel 8. Analisis Regresi Pengaruh Pendidikan terhadap Religiositas WVS 4") |>
  align(align = "center", part = "all") |>
  colformat_num(
    j = c("Koefisien", "Std. Error", "p-value"),
    digits = 3
  ) |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |>
  fontsize(size = 12, part = "all") |>
  autofit() |>
  add_footer_lines(
    values = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(r2, 3),
      "; Adjusted R² = ", round(adj_r2, 3)
    )
  ) |> font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer")

    p.value = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p.value, 3)),
    Signif = case_when(
      p.value == "<0.001" ~ "***",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.01 ~ "**",
      as.numeric(p.value) < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  ) |>
  select(Variabel, estimate, std.error, CI, p.value, Signif) |>
  rename(
    Koefisien = estimate,
    `Std. Error` = std.error,
    `CI (95%)` = CI,
    `p-value` = p.value
  )
